precedence: This override is higher authority for production recovery method, shared Worker deployment safety, manual parent-email routing/idempotency and its Admin UI counters. All non-conflicting Portal V2 authority remains binding.

prohibited: git revert as a recovery mechanism
deploying an older entrypoint to recover one feature
undoing later valid Admin, Trial, Quiz, resource, batch, navigation or portal changes while fixing another defect
ownerDirective.requiredMethod: Start from current main and current production composition, identify the defective layer, preserve all later valid capabilities, apply a forward-only fix, and fail closed if preservation cannot be proved.

sharedWorkerInvariant.compositionRequirement: The shared Worker deployment must retain the complete current composition chain and bindings, including quiz bridge, Admin tools, lesson-release import, Trial runtime, Replace Resource, read-model publication and parent email capability.
sharedWorkerInvariant.parentEmailTestRoutingProductionRule: PARENT_EMAIL_TEST_TO must be blank in production live-parent mode.

parentEmailIncident.cause: A production test-recipient binding routed manual parent emails to the owner while the successful test delivery still consumed the normal parent-delivery idempotency record.
parentEmailIncident.ownerObservedRecovery: PASS: the Admin Console reported 2 parent emails sent after the two incident delivery records were re-armed.
parentEmailIncident.liveRule: A delivery sent to a test recipient must never be recorded as delivery to the intended parent. Production must not silently substitute a test recipient for the parent.

manualEmailUi.automaticImportRule: CSV import changes Portal access only; parent emails remain a separate deliberate manual action.
manualEmailUi.counterDefect: After a successful manual send, the green status banner reflected the manual result but summary pills retained the earlier automatic-import summary, producing a stale emailsSent:0 display.
manualEmailUi.requiredUiRule: After manual send, refresh summary counters from the manual-send response without triggering any second send.

preservationInvariants: Never roll back production to fix an Admin Console defect.
Never use an automatic rollback step in a production workflow.
Preserve current later-valid changes when correcting an earlier layer.
Automatic CSV import must not send parent emails.
Manual send must remain idempotent for actual parent deliveries.
Test routing must not consume live-parent duplicate protection.
Do not resend a parent email solely to repair stale UI counters.
verificationRequirements: Prove current shared Worker entrypoint and required bindings before deployment.
Run shared-capability preservation tests before mutation.
Verify PARENT_EMAIL_TEST_TO is blank for production live-parent routing.
Verify quiz bridge, Replace Resource, lesson-release import and Trial runtime markers remain present after deployment.
Verify any incident-specific idempotency repair targets only the known incident window/records.
Record resulting production workflow run and update GCH authority.
